title: Thai-Style Udon Noodle Stir Fry
description: A simple and flavorful stir-fry made with udon noodles, vegetables, and your choice of protein. This recipe is quick, easy, and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the soft khao (mushrooms) and cook until they start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the quenched noodles (bell peppers) and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the udon noodles and cook until they are heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the pad thai sauce and stir-fry everything together for about 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
